messages:
kevin: noticed a 3x jump in eu-west inference p95 token latency starting ~14:02 UTC, correlates with runtime deploy 02:00 (commit f3a2c9)
maria: saw same, dashboards show batch wait queue backlog and kv-cache miss rate up
raj: adding context: hotpool utilization at 98%, eviction rate spiked, small nodes CPU steal on proxy
infra-alerts: [ALERT] eu-west inference pod latency p95 > 400ms for 5m
kevin: can we shift traffic off eu-west to na1 for customers with cross-region routing? :thinking:
lisa: we have capacity in na1 reserved hotpool (2x GPUs free). propose immediate traffic-shift to na1 for non-SLA customers to buy time
maria: recommendation: toggle runtime flag `kv_cache_prefetch=true` back to false, and scale hotpool by +4 GPUs in eu-west as stopgap
raj: +1 on rollback of recent batching affinity change. The commit introduced per-model packing heuristic causing tiny batches -> high overhead
kevin: ops-runner executing scale up: `./infra scale hotpool eu-west 4 --reason "latency spike" --ticket #INF-3421`
ops-runner: started scale operation (op-9832). ETA ~90s per GPU. monitoring
maria: also opening canary traffic-shift: redirect 30% of new sessions to na1 via smartrouter policy id sr-77
kevin: applied policy sr-77, now 30% to na1. p95 in eu-west still climbing
deploy-bot: rollback triggered: reverted commit f3a2c9 -> 7b1e0d, deploy started to runtime-eu-1 (deploy-4821)
raj: good. I'll check KV cache telemetry. dumping latest logs:
```
2026-03-18T14:05:12Z kvcache: miss_rate=0.67 avg_batch_size=1.3 queue_len=120
2026-03-18T14:05:15Z runtime: batch_affinity_change applied model=llama-70b
```
lisa: after rollback, p95 dropped from 420ms -> 180ms in ~90s for a small subset
kevin: hotpool scale finished, GPUs provisioned in 110s. op-9832 complete
ops-runner: scale op completed (op-9832). Hotpool size eu-west now 18 -> 22
maria: smartrouter metrics: na1 p95 steady 160ms, eu-west p95 trending down to 170ms
raj: KV cache miss rate falling back to normal ~0.12
kevin: thanks. policy sr-77 keep for now at 30% to maintain headroom. we'll start gradual 10% rollback to eu-west after 20m if stable
maria: filing postmortem ticket INF-3421 with timeline and action items: rollback gating, unit test for batch affinity, autoscale pacing change
kevin: immediate action items: (1) permanent revert of affinity heuristic until canary passes, (2) add predeploy perf smoke in eu-west, (3) improve hotpool prewarming and probe latency
lisa: ping @oncall for follow-up and customer comms
infra-alerts: incident annotated: mitigation applied: rollback + hotpool scale + traffic shift. Severity: sev2 -> monitoring
kevin: closing thread for rapid updates, continue async in INF-3421. :thumbsup:
